summary: Sacks is bearish on SSI's prospects because its safety-first mandate acts as a governor that will slow it down relative to competitors like OpenAI who are racing to build AGI as fast as possible, creating a Darwinian disadvantage.
quote: I'm not bullish about that pitch... safety concerns are a brake pedal. They don't help you move faster, they make you move slower... you're the guys who want to move slower. I don't think that's the recipe for winning.
